base_prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one front-facing idle NPC sprite for a low-resolution top-down pixel-art browser game. Redraw Kirin from input images 2 and 3, matching the visual language and proportions of the player sprite in input image 1 EXACTLY. Image 1 is the style/proportion reference only, not the character identity. Kirin has brown skin, dark brown hair in a high ponytail, dark rectangular glasses, a light-blue short-sleeve T-shirt, dark blue trousers and white sneakers. Her head must be large, about 42 percent of the total height, her body short and chunky, with short relaxed arms, feet slightly apart and facing the viewer. Use a very coarse underlying logical pixel grid of approximately 23 pixels wide by 36 pixels tall, enlarged with clean hard square pixels. A friendly, simple face, glasses readable in a few dark pixels, no fine facial rendering. Match image 1's very low detail, dark brown stepped outline, flat small color palette, blocky compact silhouette and large head. Single full-body sprite only, centered, occupying almost all the canvas height, approximately 2:3 width-to-height silhouette. Real transparent alpha background, no scenery, no text, no frame, no grid, no shadow or glow, no anti-aliased or smooth edges. Do not output a sprite sheet or multiple poses. Do not make a skinny realistically proportioned character.
final_edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit input image 1 only. Keep the pixel-art Kirin sprite's exact pose, large-head compact proportions, silhouette, ponytail, hair color, glasses, eyes, mouth, blue shirt, jeans, shoes, position and framing unchanged. Change ONLY exposed skin colors on face, ears, neck, arms and hands: lighten the warm tan skin to a light-medium warm peach complexion, halfway between image 1's current medium tan and image 2's pale peach skin. Target the main midtone around #E5B88B, with darker peach shadows and softly lighter peach highlights. Do not make her as pale as image 2. Preserve the existing hard square pixel shapes. Do not alter anything else and do not add any new details or shadows. Real transparent alpha background; no outer glow, no ground shadow. Return exactly one full-body sprite, not a scene or sheet.
grin_edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this approved pixel-art Kirin sprite with ONE tiny change: replace her small neutral mouth with a modest friendly grin showing a narrow strip of white teeth. The grin should be only about four logical pixel blocks wide and one block high, with small dark mouth corners. Keep the smile subtle and readable at small game size. Preserve absolutely everything else exactly: skin color, glasses, eyes, blush, face shape, hair and ponytail, proportions, clothes, shoes, pose, pixel grid, silhouette, framing, and real transparent background. Do not enlarge her mouth into a big open smile. No other changes. Output one single full-body transparent sprite.
